language.label: Language
language.error: The language could not be saved. Please try again.

sender.identitiesHelp: Addresses this mailbox can send from. Check send-as permission with the mail provider before enabling an address. This is separate from your mailbox role.
sender.managerOnly: Only mailbox managers can change sender identities.
sender.chooseDefaultBeforeDisable: Choose another mailbox default before disabling this identity.
sender.replyToHelp: Optional single address; replies go here instead of From.
sender.senderPreferencesHelp: Personal From and signature for this mailbox
sender.personalSignatureHelp: Overrides the template choice. Empty text explicitly means no signature.
sender.placeholdersHelp: Supported placeholders: '{{user.name}}', '{{user.email}}', '{{identity.displayName}}', '{{identity.email}}'. Add job titles as plain text.
sender.invalidTemplate: Use only the supported signature placeholders (maximum 8 KiB).
sender.sharedTemplatesHelp: Manage shared mailbox templates. Personal signature overrides are in Preferences. Supported placeholders: '{{user.name}}', '{{user.email}}', '{{identity.displayName}}', '{{identity.email}}'.

sender.unavailableDraft: This draft's From address is unavailable. Choose an enabled sender and save the draft.
sender.chooseEnabledSender: Choose an enabled From address before sending.
sender.confirmKeepEditedSignature: Keep the edited signature and add the new signature? Your edited text will be preserved.
sender.confirmKeepEditedWithoutSignature: Keep the edited signature text and stop tracking it as a signature?

sender.senderLoadFailed: Could not load sender identities and preferences.
sender.senderUnavailable: Sender settings are unavailable for this mailbox.
sender.templateUnavailable: A signature template is unavailable. Review your signature preferences. Ask a mailbox manager to repair the shared template.
sender.identityUnavailable: This From address is unavailable. Choose an enabled sender and save the draft.
sender.draftIdentityChanged: The saved sender details changed. Review From and save the draft before sending.
sender.senderRejected: The mail provider rejected this From address. Choose another sender or ask a mailbox manager to review it.
sender.recipientRejected: The mail provider rejected a recipient. Review To, Cc and Bcc before trying again.
sender.messageRejected: The mail provider rejected this message. Review its content and attachments.
sender.providerTemporary: The mail provider is temporarily unavailable. Keep this draft and try again later.
sender.providerConfiguration: Sending is unavailable. Ask a mailbox manager to review the mail configuration.
sender.providerConnection: Could not connect to the mail provider. Keep this draft and try again later.
sender.providerFailure: The mail provider could not process this message. Keep this draft and contact a mailbox manager.
sender.connectionTimeout: Connecting to the mail provider timed out. Keep this draft and try again later.
sender.greetingTimeout: The mail provider did not respond in time. Keep this draft and try again later.
sender.deliveryUncertain: The mail provider timed out. Delivery may have succeeded; check Sent and with the recipient before sending again.
sender.personalDefaultUnavailable: Your default identity is unavailable. Choose an enabled identity in Preferences, or ask a mailbox manager to re-enable it.
sender.savedIdentityUnavailable: The saved draft identity is unavailable. Review sender and save the draft.
sender.identityExists: An identity with this address already exists.
sender.defaultIdentityRequired: Choose another mailbox default before disabling this identity.
sender.signatureInUse: This signature is used by a sender identity. Choose another template for that identity first.
sender.invalidPreferences: Review your sender preferences and signature placeholders.
